thm r44_sqrt_two_newton_gap_contracts_quadratically:
    ? forall n N:
        r44_sqrt_two_newton_gap(n + 1) <= r44_sqrt_two_newton_gap(n)^2 / 4
    release thm r44_sqrt_two_newton_iterate_at_least_one(n)
    r44_sqrt_two_newton_iterate(n) >= 1
    r44_sqrt_two_newton_iterate(n) - 1 $in R
    r44_sqrt_two_newton_iterate(n) + 1 $in R
    r44_sqrt_two_newton_iterate(n) - 1 >= 0
    r44_sqrt_two_newton_iterate(n) + 1 > 0
    r44_sqrt_two_newton_iterate(n) + 1 >= 0
    (r44_sqrt_two_newton_iterate(n) - 1) * (r44_sqrt_two_newton_iterate(n) + 1) >= 0
    r44_sqrt_two_newton_iterate(n)^2 - 1 = (r44_sqrt_two_newton_iterate(n) - 1) * (r44_sqrt_two_newton_iterate(n) + 1) >= 0
    0 <= r44_sqrt_two_newton_iterate(n)^2 - 1
    1 <= r44_sqrt_two_newton_iterate(n)^2
    r44_sqrt_two_newton_iterate(n)^2 >= 1
    r44_sqrt_two_newton_gap(n + 1) = |r44_square_root_two_residual(r44_sqrt_two_newton_iterate(n + 1))|
    |r44_square_root_two_residual(r44_sqrt_two_newton_iterate(n + 1))| >= 0
    r44_sqrt_two_newton_gap(n + 1) >= 0
    r44_sqrt_two_newton_gap(n + 1) $in R
    r44_sqrt_two_newton_iterate(n)^2 $in R
    0 <= r44_sqrt_two_newton_gap(n + 1)
    1 * r44_sqrt_two_newton_gap(n + 1) <= r44_sqrt_two_newton_iterate(n)^2 * r44_sqrt_two_newton_gap(n + 1)
    0 <= 4
    4 * (1 * r44_sqrt_two_newton_gap(n + 1)) <= 4 * (r44_sqrt_two_newton_iterate(n)^2 * r44_sqrt_two_newton_gap(n + 1))
    4 * (1 * r44_sqrt_two_newton_gap(n + 1)) = 4 * r44_sqrt_two_newton_gap(n + 1)
    4 * (r44_sqrt_two_newton_iterate(n)^2 * r44_sqrt_two_newton_gap(n + 1)) = 4 * r44_sqrt_two_newton_iterate(n)^2 * r44_sqrt_two_newton_gap(n + 1)
    4 * r44_sqrt_two_newton_gap(n + 1) <= 4 * r44_sqrt_two_newton_iterate(n)^2 * r44_sqrt_two_newton_gap(n + 1)
    release thm r44_sqrt_two_newton_gap_step_identity(n)
    4 * r44_sqrt_two_newton_iterate(n)^2 * r44_sqrt_two_newton_gap(n + 1) = r44_sqrt_two_newton_gap(n)^2
    4 * r44_sqrt_two_newton_gap(n + 1) <= r44_sqrt_two_newton_gap(n)^2
